title: Delivery Promise and Cutoff Terms by Method - Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders
content:
Delivery or pickup readiness on Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders is promised a set number of business days after the order date, and an order placed after the method's cutoff time counts as placed the next day for that promise. Fulfillment Operations publishes these service levels per method.

| Fulfillment method | Promise (business days after the order date; 0 means the same day) | Order cutoff, store or warehouse local time | Fulfillment fee refunded when delivery misses the promise | Same-day grace after the promised window end (minutes) | Signature required on delivery | Delivery address may be changed before the order ships |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Ship-to-Home | 5 | 23:59 | No | 0 | No | Yes |
| Expedited Ship-to-Home | 2 | 13:00 | Yes | 0 | No | Yes |
| Buy Online Pick Up In Store | 0 | 20:00 | No | 0 | No | No |
| Curbside Pickup | 0 | 20:00 | No | 0 | No | No |
| Same-Day Delivery | 0 | 14:00 | Yes | 30 | No | No |
| Large Item Freight Delivery | 10 | 12:00 | No | 0 | Yes | Yes |

### Terms used in the table

- **Promise** - the business days after the order date by which delivery, or readiness for pickup, is promised; an integer, with 0 meaning the same day.
- **Order cutoff** - the store or warehouse local time (HH:MM) after which an order counts as placed the next day for the promise.
- **Fee refunded on a missed promise** - whether the method refunds the fulfillment fee when delivery misses the promise.
- **Same-day grace** - the minutes after the end of the promised delivery window before a Same-Day Delivery order counts as late.
- **Signature required** - whether the delivery requires a signature.
- **Address change before shipping** - whether the delivery address may be changed before the order ships.

### Illustrations (hypothetical orders)

- A hypothetical Expedited Ship-to-Home order placed at 13:05 local time is after the 13:00 cutoff, so its two business days are counted from the next day.
- A hypothetical Standard Ship-to-Home order placed at 21:30 is before the 23:59 cutoff and is counted from its own order date.
- Only Expedited Ship-to-Home and Same-Day Delivery are marked for a fulfillment fee refund on a missed promise; only Same-Day Delivery has a grace period, of 30 minutes.
